items.description: This Fairywork is popular when celebrating the arrival of spring. Caution: Inhaling the powder has been known to create psychedelic hallucinations as powerful as the Fairywork itself.

items.name: Emote Scroll: Steamy
items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Foggernaut class's special emote.

items.name: Minor Dynamo
items.description: This idol seems to have lost its power.

items.name: Droid Potion
items.description: After having drunk it, you'll talk in metallic noises and punctuate your sentences with beeps and whistles.

items.name: Raid Mohr Potion
items.description: The ads for this potion assure you that it's capable of waking the dead. But they don't mention what happens when you spray it on the living...

items.name: Divination Potion
items.description: The Xelor lobby is trying to outlaw the sale of this potion based on a whole bunch of made-up pretexts, simply because it threatens their monopoly. Any resemblance to any or all existing lobbies is purely coincidental.

items.name: Rad Dit Potion
items.description: This potion was invented by an alchemist who wanted to keep the uneducated away from his creations. It had the opposite effect though - it draw the attention of many Astrubians.

items.name: Field Potion
items.description: Ecaflips appreciate that this potion lets them tempt fate with a stroke of luck.

items.name: Praying Potion
items.description: This potion is served to the city's condemned just before their decapitation.

items.name: Pythag Potion
items.description: Creators abuse this potion when they're short on ideas.

items.name: Margedelweiss Potion
items.description: Alchemists sell the Margedelweiss Potion as a Dofus detector. Of course, Astrubians have cleaned out the stock.

items.name: Judj Raid Potion
items.description: Is justice immutable in your eyes? Are you the victim of a hasty condemnation you couldn't contest? This potion will get you back on your feet and continuing your misdeeds discreetly.

items.name: Trool's Blood
items.description: An alchemist wanted to reproduce Trools' ability to regenerate. Since taking blood from the source seemed to miss the point, the alchemist decided to synthesize it instead.

items.name: Tri Potion
items.description: Pandawas look down on the exportation of this non-alcoholic potion.

items.name: Raid Mption Potion
items.description: For the dead who aren't quite dead, and still have a lot to make up for.

items.name: Goku Potion
items.description: This potion won't make you a super warrior. Reported side-effects include: hairy tails, primate transformation.

items.name: Raid Izded Potion
items.description: According to some rumours, Emile is the killer. This potion was created to give the victims a second chance.

items.name: Tear of Eniripsa
items.description: The tears of the Goddess are rumoured to heal many injuries, but that doesn't explain why her disciples are such wimpy crybabies.

items.name: Donzel Potion
items.description: Used as a lotion, it will make you young and pretty, even if you're a man.

items.name: Revitalizing Potion
items.description: This potion is great for getting the injured back on their feet and out massacring innocent creatures.

items.name: Cheesemonger Potion
items.description: The mould in this potion is not hazardous to your health - so long as you're already dead.

items.name: White Bread
items.description: The minstrel Davyd created this bread for people who, like him, don't mince words.

items.name: Gingerbread
items.description: This bread gets its name from the way it's prepared, namely by a red-headed baker named Matthew.

items.name: Waffle
items.description: This waffle is a particular favourite of many politicians. The most interesting thing is what you put on it.

items.name: Golden Waffle
items.description: This cake first appeared in Astrub. Since then, it's become quite popular and can be found near Zaaps and in the marketplaces of numerous cities.

items.name: Faluche
items.description: Trools have a tendency to confuse this bread with a hat. No one's quite certain why.

items.name: Burnet
items.description: The Bearman himself perfected the recipe of this bread, inspired by a particularly bad bout of indigestion.

items.name: Tortilla
items.description: One thing you've got to remember: tortillas are like pies – they've better well-filled.

items.name: Burrito
items.description: This dish used to be quite popular at drinking parties on the coral beach.

items.name: Fouace
items.description: It's like a pita, only not.

items.name: Rotisserie Eel
items.description: Here's a fish that will never again try to slip out of your hands.

items.name: Rotisserie Rock Eel
items.description: A favourite amongst paranoids, investigators, and tax inspectors.

items.name: Baked Sea Bream
items.description: Revenge is a dish best served cold. Or like this.

items.name: Baked Royal Sea Bream
items.description: Royal revenge is a dish best served cold. Or like this.

items.name: Monkfish Salad
items.description: When it's cooked this way, this fish reminds you of the feast the Kanniballs organised when your grandfather passed away.

items.name: Humonkfish Salad
items.description: Butchers look poorly on this competing salad being on the market.

items.name: Cod Stew
items.description: The Kanniballs created this recipe, but since their diet is frowned upon in Allister's kingdom, Amaknians have adapted it with fish.

items.name: Bearded Cod Stew
items.description: This deluxe dish is only available from Kanniball chefs because of the rarity of Bearded Cod.

items.name: Tench Matelote
items.description: During difficult fights, imagine your teammates in the place of this fish.

items.name: Haunted Tench Matelote
items.description: You're quaking with fear at the idea that this fish could be a reincarnated teammate.

items.name: Panned Swordfish
items.description: If you play with fire too much, you'll get burned. A lesson that's just a bit too late for this fish.

items.name: Panned Quixote Swordfish
items.description: This fish's dreams of grandeur led it all the way to this plate.

items.name: Nyoro
items.description: This idol seems to have lost its power. However, it now makes a strange sound when you shake it. Maybe try breaking it open to see what's inside.

items.name: Sack of Ginseng
items.description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Ginseng.

items.description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Belladonna.

items.name: Flesh Bullion
items.description: This insipid dish is part of the traditional Incarnam cuisine.

items.name: Famished Sunflower Soup
items.description: Ronan the Barbarian's mother frequently told him to drink his soup to become big. One can guess that he must not have ever listened.

items.name: Beach Sweet
items.description: Contrary to what any Iops might have told you, you can actually eat this anywhere, not just the beach.

items.name: Sponge Mob Sweet
items.description: The method of preparing this meat before cooking it in paper guarantees an inimitable taste.

items.name: Batofu Beignet
items.description: This beignet, adored by Rekojeht, makes a disturbing smile play across his lips every time he has one.

items.name: Field Pan Fry
items.description: It will have you dancing in the fields, if you weren't already. Admit it. You were.

items.name: Treechnidian Round in Pepper Sauce
items.description: Children prefer food that is simple, fatty, sugary or salty to fancy food and peppers.

items.name: Golden Scarabugly Ball
items.description: This ball shines more than the ones you make with your boogers, but rest assured, it's harder to flick with your fingers.

items.name: Vilinsekt Grillade
items.description: The best thing about this meat isn't the taste, but the noise the Vilinsekt makes when it's cooked.

items.name: Kickroach Grillade
items.description: Thankfully, Kickroach is impossible to hear, because the obscenities that it shouted while being cooked would make even a Rogue blush.

items.name: Onion-Flavoured Marrow Bone
items.description: It doesn't matter where you get the onions - what matters is that you get them.

items.name: Onion-Flavoured Ronin Chafer Marrow Bone
items.description: This dish gives off an odour strangely similar to your breath when you wake up, which is why cooks often use it to keep stray cats away.

items.name: Blop Bullion
items.description: Since there are idiots everywhere for whom common sense is nothing but a legend, this dish comes with the notice: "Do not consume while burning - risk of serious burn."

items.name: Salted Shin Larva
items.description: This off-white, aniseed-flavoured liquid squirting into your mouth when you bite into this larva reminds you of certain drunken nights.

items.name: Bandit Cottage Pie
items.description: Accompanied by potatoes, this dish is perfect for getting Bandits ready for their future stays in Brakmar jails.

items.name: Smiths' Chest Cottage Pie
items.description: Accompanied by potato peels, this dish is perfect for getting Bandits ready for their future stays in Brakmar jails.

items.name: Bwork Andouillette
items.description: Not knowing what to do with their tripe, the Bworks decided to eat it to give them courage.

items.name: Alchemist Gem
items.description: This gem will give you experience in your Alchemist career.

items.name: Bworkette Andouillette
items.description: After eating this dish, your breath will be able to kill a Bwork.

items.name: Jeweller Gem
items.description: This gem will give you experience in your Jeweller career.

items.name: Handyman Gem
items.description: This gem will give you experience in your Handyman career.

items.name: Lumberjack Gem
items.description: This gem will give you experience in your Lumberjack career.

items.description: This gem will give you experience in your Hunter career.

items.description: This gem will give you experience in your Shoemagus career.

items.name: Costumagus Gem
items.description: This gem will give you experience in your Costumagus career.

items.name: Artificer Gem
items.description: This gem will give you experience in your Artificer career.

items.name: Smithmagus Gem
items.description: This gem will give you experience in your Smithmagus career.

items.name: Ashy Coral
items.description: A hole in the sand, a fire on the beach, food rolled in ash and everything's taken care of. The hardest part is getting a Coralator to participate.

items.name: Smith Gem
items.description: This gem will give you experience in your Smith career.

items.name: Jewelmagus Gem
items.description: This gem will give you experience in your Jewelmagus career.

items.name: Miner Gem
items.description: This gem will give you experience in your Miner career.

items.name: Farmer Gem
items.description: This gem will give you experience in your Farmer career.

items.name: Ashy Great Coral
items.description: A hole in the sand, a fire on the beach, food rolled in ash and everything's taken care of. The hardest part is getting the Great Coralator out of his grotto.

items.name: Fisherman Gem
items.description: This gem will give you experience in your Fisherman career.

items.name: Carvmagus Gem
items.description: This gem will give you experience in your Carvmagus career.

items.name: Carver Gem
items.description: This gem will give you experience in your Carver career.

items.name: Tailor Gem
items.description: This gem will give you experience in your Tailor career.

items.name: Ash-Coated Bulb Tart
items.description: Less violent than the last time you took a pie to the kisser, this pie is also lighter.

items.name: Ash-Coated Bulbig Brotha Tart
items.description: A Pandawa custom says the Bulbig Brotha Tart should be shared with your family.

items.name: Blop Marinade
items.description: This is what happens when a Blop drowns.

items.name: Royal Blop Marinade
items.description: This is what happens when a Royal Blop tries to learn to swim.

items.name: Spiced Jelly
items.description: This fatty, sugary, and salty mixture is recommended if you're managing bad cholesterol, diabetes, or gout.

items.name: Spiced Royal Jelly
items.description: This fatty, sugary, and salty mixture is recommended if you want bad cholesterol, diabetes, or gout.

items.name: Boiled Turtle
items.description: I LIKE TURTLES!

items.name: Kanniball Andouillette
items.description: Sometimes, a Kanniball's rite of passage ceremony goes very wrong, much to the delight of their peers.

items.name: Kanniball Andchain Andouillette
items.description: When the Kanniball chief is no longer fit to rule, he's divided among the members of his tribe. The one that accidentally stabs their palate with a bone while eating the old chief becomes the new one.

items.name: Axle Wose Potion
items.description: This potion won't make you more attractive, but it might make your hair grow.

items.name: Country Rat Jowl
items.description: Believing that a farmer had been used as the basis of this dish, a Iop knight decided to avenge his death. Which explains the decided lack of rats in the fields.

items.name: Steamed Ethereal Tripe
items.description: There is only one way to cook this dish, which makes the sight of it all the more unsettling.

items.name: Steamed Shiny Ethereal Tripe
items.description: There is only one way to cook this dish, which makes the sight of it in the dark possible.

items.name: Crackler Bullion
items.description: The advantage of Crackler Bullion is that it can be directly cooked on a stone, giving a smooth and even broth.

items.name: Legendary Crackler Bullion
items.description: Drinking this bullion won't make you a legend, but you'll avoid dying of hunger and thirst, and hey, that's a start.

items.name: Grilled Marrow Bone
items.description: There's not a lot there to eat, but one single mouthful will be enough to send you to Ingloriom.

items.name: Grilled Gourlo the Terrible Marrow Bone
items.description: There's not a lot there to eat, but one single mouthful will be enough to send you to the Shustuft Crust.

items.name: Smoked Wa Wobot Jowl
items.description: Along with a glass of cawwot juice, this dish is positively regal.

items.name: Kitsou Offal Lemonade
items.description: The acidity of the lemon offsets the high PH of the offal, which almost makes it edible.

items.name: Daggero Offal Lemonade
items.description: The acidity of the lemon offsets the high PH of the offal, which almost makes it good.

items.name: Brain Salad
items.description: For a moment, you wonder if it's the remains of last night's vomit, then you remember that your Bow Wow already took care of that mess for you.

items.name: Dark Vlad Brain Salad
items.description: You're too hungry to ask yourself if this is leftovers of last night's vomit.

items.name: Vegetarian Stir Fry
items.description: Frying makes up for the lack of fat in vegetarian dishes.

items.name: Dark Treechnidian Round Grillade
items.description: This savoury dish will make vegetarians as happy as carnivores.

items.name: Ancestral Treechnid Round Grillade
items.description: Butchers refuse to taste this food because they worry they'll be turned into a Treechnid.

items.name: Arak-hai Terrine in Jelly
items.description: The less you know about this terrine, the better.

items.name: Rac Queen Terrine in Jelly
items.description: Theoretically, cooking this dish will have killed the Arak-hai eggs. If not, you'll soon have a lot more children to take care of.

items.name: Boiled Marrow Bone
items.description: It's not advisable to drink the juice that accompanies this dish, unless you want to have a shape similar to a Pandora.

items.name: Boiled LeChouque Marrow Bone
items.description: This dish is so ridiculously small that it would only satisfy a Vilinsekt.

items.name: Exotic Salad
items.description: A culinary specialty of Moon Island, this recipe disappeared after the arrival of the Kanniballs.

items.name: Exotic Brain Salad
items.description: Since they arrived on Moon Island, the Kanniballs have adapted the recipe of this exotic salad.

items.name: Krtek Cottage Pie
items.description: To appreciate the true value of this dish, you must add Apis and dirt. Or at least, that's the way Iops explain it.

items.name: Braised Gobball
items.description: The taste of this meat will be worth the twelve hours you'll have to wait for it to cook.

items.name: Braised Koolich
items.description: Obviously, it's not the actual Koolich, because you'd have to cut down every tree in Amakna just to cook it.

items.name: Krismahlo Pemmican
items.description: This meat can keep for decades without its taste or nutritional qualities changing.

items.name: Puppet Master Pemmican
items.description: Giles Verne advises Foggernauts to take this meat with them on all their long trips.

items.name: Spiced Strongboxer
items.description: It takes a lot of spice to mask the metallic taste of this dish.

items.name: Spiced Brutatax
items.description: The spices accentuate the auriferous taste of this dish, which should satisfy the greediest Enutrof.

items.name: Stuffed Ouassinge Stomach
items.description: The stuffing is comprised of everything the Ouassinge absorbed before dying. With luck, there are even some edible parts.

items.name: Rat Jowl Stew
items.description: It's not a bad idea to eat before combat in order to excuse your inefficiency.

items.name: Black Rat Jowl Stew
items.description: Only hardened Brakmarians are able to swallow this meat without belching flames. So Oto Mustam deliberately distributed it to young recruits during important battles.

items.name: White Rat Jowl Stew
items.description: Notable Bontarians eat this dish with an infamous taste in order to seem different and show they're not like everyone else - and, indeed, no one else eats it.

items.name: Herb-Rubbed Sirloin Steak Salad
items.description: Otomai's disciples adore consuming anything made from alcohol or herbs, which led them to create this recipe.

items.name: Silf the Greater Bherb Sirloin Steak Salad
items.description: It's well known that eat Silf the Greater Bherb accompanied by cocktails loosens tongues. Certain of Otomai's more unscrupulous disciples have even used this fact to obtain information about the Turquoise Dofus.

items.name: Baked Crobak Liver Paté
items.description: Many chefs have tried to reproduce this recipe by putting common Crobaks directly in the oven, but without success.

items.name: Baked Lord Crow Liver Paté
items.description: Not everyone can cook this meat, and even fewer can pay for it.

items.name: Koalak Sausage
items.description: It's slightly more effective for digging a small hole than being used as food.

items.name: Skeunk Sausage
items.description: This pudding has a pretty bad taste, but it's still popular with Astrubian youths.

items.name: Royal Rainbow Blop Marinade
items.description: This is what happens when a Royal Rainbow Blop confuses a plate with its bathtub.

items.name: Minos Hock Stew
items.description: From now on, you'll be able to draw the Minotoror's labyrinth in your plate.

items.name: Mintoror Hock Stew
items.description: Whatever the Minotoror was plotting doesn't matter now that it's in your plate.

items.name: Tofu Strip Pan Fry
items.description: Tastes like Tofu.

items.name: Royal Tofu Strip Pan Fry
items.description: Not everyone gets a chance to taste this royal dish.

items.name: Pandissident Liver Salad
items.description: This balanced dish comes with it's own drink to accompany it.

items.name: Pandora Master Liver Salad
items.description: Consumed in excess, this salad quickly goes to the head, and will make you do inadmissible things, like vomiting in your boots, or worse, your neighbours'.

items.name: Grilled Xelomorph Pie
items.description: This pie has a more regular shape than the "pies" your mount creates.

items.name: Grilled Fraktal Pie
items.description: Some prefer it square, some like it triangular, and the worst are those that refuse to eat it if it's not shaped like jigsaw pieces.

items.name: Zoth Sausage
items.description: Each year, the stupidest Zoths get together at the Zaap to compare the length of their sausages. The longest gets the honour of being revered as a god by his peers.

items.name: Tanukouï San Breast in Jelly
items.description: No matter what you've been told, jelly will never replace real fresh meat.

items.name: Marinated Malitiaman Flank
items.description: The original recipe used water from the Shrouded Canals for the marinade, but most tourists couldn't handle it and ended up in the Os-Piss.

items.name: Marinated Captain Scarlight Flank
items.description: Much progress has been made recently in the treatment of the Shrouded Canals water used for the marinade, which has reduced the number of consumer deaths by an order of magnitude.

items.name: Firefoux Roulade
items.description: Everyone has their own special way of preparing this dish: rolling it in their armpits, mud, or, rarely, flour.

items.name: Peki Peki Roulade
items.description: Few cooks dare prepare this dish - not because it's difficult to prepare, but because collecting the ingredients can be fatal.

items.name: Sautéed Short-Tempered Treechnidian Round
items.description: How short-tempered can it be after having been sautéed? Apparently, the answer is: very.

items.name: Sautéed Soft Oak Round
items.description: You'll be able to invite your in-laws to dinner without them thinking you're trying to poison them.

items.name: Rotisserie Fleurizome Round
items.description: This 100% vegetarian round should be served just barely cooked.

items.name: Rotisserie Tynril Round
items.description: If you eat it, you'll feel better.

items.name: Diced Amakna Rat Jowl
items.description: If, after throwing one of these six-sided die, you get an eight, you've probably spent too much time on Nolifis Island.

items.name: Diced Sphincter Cell Jowl
items.description: This dish has a slight taste of sausage pizza.

items.name: Breaded Ectoplasmic Meat
items.description: This meat is served to adventurers who want to brave the ocean's fury without ever leaving the Gobball fields.

items.name: Breaded Buck Anear Meat
items.description: Be careful Buck Anear doesn't come to take this piece of meat back from your stomach.

items.name: Spiced Drheller Muzzle
items.description: If you'd like to live a long, healthy life, avoid inviting Enutoughs to share this meal with you.

items.name: Spiced Drhossil Muzzle
items.description: When Dhyan Fossi asked you to calm the Drhossil down, she never suspected you'd use such cruel methods.

items.name: Minotot Hock Stew
items.description: When you think of all the slaves dying of starvation every day in the Stontusk Desert, you'll be more appreciative of this dish's taste.

items.name: Sym Filet
items.description: Not to be confused with Sim, an old Enutrof whose as funny as your Dad's jokes...

items.name: Kimbo Filet
items.description: The rules of gastronomy say this meat should be eaten cooked every other day, and raw the days in between.

items.name: Toadorous Terrine
items.description: No one is singing the praises of this terrine.

items.name: Obsidemon Terrine
items.description: There's always a small risk of breaking a tooth while eating this terrine.

items.name: Stuffed Giant Kralove Stomach
items.description: The stuffing is easy to prepare: you just need to gather the remains of several adventures who failed to defeat the Giant Kralove.

items.name: Fuji Snowfoux Steak
items.description: This steak gives off an intoxicating perfumed odour which awakens males' reproductive instinct, and repels females.

items.name: Altdemon Pudding
items.description: No matter what it's made of, puddings remain a favourite dish of Twelvians.

items.name: XLII Sausage
items.description: This long and large sausage will fill with pleasure those lucky enough to get a taste.

items.name: Bwork Laap
items.description: Serving this meat cooked instead of raw is a sacrilege which should be punished with being drowned in cheap wine.

items.name: Bworker Laap
items.description: As you may have heard, the longer it is, the less short it is.

items.name: Fried Mushrooms
items.description: These mushrooms will help you understand everything.

items.name: Fried Ougaa Mushrooms
items.description: Frying is the only cooking method known to inhibit the deadly substances found in these mushrooms. And that means that all the other methods had to be tested before they were known not to work.

items.name: Vegetarian Plate
items.description: This dish, targeted at tourists, is but a pale and cheap imitation of the famous salad with Rattedaugue vinaigrette.

items.name: Vegetarian Plate with Korriander
items.description: This dish was developed for consumers whose palates couldn't handle a salad dressed with Rattedaugue vinaigrette.

items.name: Necrotick Ball
items.description: This ball has the consistency and flavour of an old booger.

items.name: Toxoliath Ball
items.description: This ball has the consistency and flavour of an old Trool booger.

items.name: Sakaian Salad
items.description: The nicest thing you can say about this dish is that it looks a lot better than it tastes.

items.name: Grohlum Sakaian Salad
items.description: Grohlum is a heavyweight, everyone knows that. This salad is no exception, and only the most solid stomachs can digest it without flinching.

items.name: Kolosso Flank Steak with Cream
items.description: Used correctly, this steak can be used as a weapon or projectile during protests.

items.name: Obscurantus Leg
items.description: Despite its imposing size, this leg has negative calories. So you can munch on it all day without gaining a kilopod. But really, would you want to?

items.name: Shadow Leg
items.description: After eating this leg, you'll feel an emptiness in your stomach. Which is why eating it is forbidden during most eating contests.

items.name: Diced Meat in Jelly
items.description: These dice are great for playing silently, even when the only surface available is a glass or marble table.

items.name: Diced Merkator Meat in Jelly
items.description: If your players have the annoying habit of throwing their dice at you when you ask them to roll them, give them these dice instead. Not only will you be able to finish your games relatively bruise-free, you won't be hungry.

items.name: Molecular Krobe Egg
items.description: Straight out of a horror show, this gelatinous fake egg has no chance of passing for a Dofus.

items.name: Molecular Protoz'orror Egg
items.description: This is the absolute latest in modern light cooking: an empty plate to keep you from gaining weight, and an exorbitant price to help your purse with the same thing.

items.name: Enutough Jelly
items.description: This dish was created for folks whose teeth have long been lost to the ravages of time and become a part of the fossil record.

items.name: Nidas Jelly
items.description: They don't serve just anything at the King's table, nor just anyONE.

items.name: Dark Court Pasties
items.description: In Srambad, they quickly ran into problems with storing bodies. A brilliant solution allows them to simultaneously solve the problem of having too many mouths to feed...

items.name: Queen of Thieves Pasties
items.description: Don't think that the Queen of Thieves would be a simple mouthful - that would be underestimating her.

items.name: Fugitive Eggplant Quenelle
items.description: This recipe was invented by Two-Fingers when he tried out cooking. He never imagined that it would be so popular with the Astrubian populace.

items.name: Vortex Eggplant Quenelle
items.description: Anyone possessing this Quenelle risks being stopped by the Order Errant.

items.name: Bag of Aubergines
items.description: This bag contains several aubergines.

items.name: Bag of Eternal Ashes
items.description: This bag contains several Eternal Ashes.

items.description: This bag contains several Cherries.

items.name: Bag of Lemons
items.description: This bag contains several Lemons.

items.description: This barrel contains several Frying Oils.

items.description: This bag contains several measures of Pepper.

items.name: Bag of Magical Cure
items.description: This bag contains several measures of Magical Cure.

items.name: Bag of Temporal Powder
items.description: This bag contains several Temporal Powders.

items.name: Bag of Resin
items.description: This bag contains several Resins.

items.name: Barrel of Scurvion Blood
items.description: This barrel contains several Scurvion Bloods.

items.name: Atolmond Beer
items.description: This beer helps reinforce the skull and other bones, which explains why Chafers are so headstrong.

items.name: Djaul Beer
items.description: Created for the elite Djaulian, in all ways better than common plebes, this beer makes one megalomaniacal and egocentric. Unfortunately, it doesn't make one smart.

items.name: Misery Beer
items.description: This beer is intended for those who don't have the means to get a Djaul Beer.

items.name: Bworkball Beer
items.description: The only difference between this beer and Bwork beer is the sulphurous aftertaste.

items.name: Emote Scroll: Salute
items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Salute emote.

items.name: Kardorim Slapper
items.description: This mechanical conception is designed to slap your mount across the face when it disobeys you. It used to be used in schools to teach young Iops to count to 5.

items.name: Emote Scroll: Ballistic
items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Cra class's special emote.

items.name: Emote Scroll: Fisherman
items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Fisherman profession's special emote.

items.name: Emote Scroll: Parasol
items.description: This scroll allows you to learn the Parasol emote.

items.name: Fair Trade Recycler
items.description:
You can upgrade an alliance prism by adding this module and then extracting the magic essence of any thingamajig you want in order to craft other stuff, which you can sell for ten times the price of a whatchamacallit.
It has been set up to fairly distribute the gains between the alliance and the recycler (50% for the character and 50% for the alliance).

items.name: Collective Recycler
items.description:
You can upgrade an alliance prism by adding this module and then extracting the magic essence of any thingamajig you want in order to craft other stuff, which you can sell for ten times the price of a whatchamacallit.
It has been set up to distribute the gains in favour of the alliance (30% for the character and 90% for the alliance).

items.name: Meatball
items.description: If cooks like to keep this recipe a closely guarded secret, it's not because they're afraid of it being copied, but in case it will be brought up in court.

items.name: Astrubian Fritter
items.description: Ever popular with the kiddies, this fritter is also favoured by adults who hate knowing exactly what they're eating.

items.name: Fortifying Astrubian Fritter
items.description: As insipid as its namesake, this fritter is the recommended diet for a Iop.

items.name: Meat Roulade
items.description: This is the favourite meal of Undertakers and Goblin merchants.

items.name: Fortifying Meat Roulade
items.description: The illustrious Ronan the Barbarian rolls these himself under the armpits of his fallen foes.

items.name: Lemon Papillote
items.description: The tartness of the lemon effectively neutralises the deadly bacteria that have developed in this meat.

items.name: Fortifying Lemon Papillote
items.description: If this dish doesn't kill you, it'll only make you stronger, that's for certain.

items.name: Sufokian Salad
items.description: When the fishing's bad, Sufokians fall back on this salad, which contains all the protein they need. Just don't ask where all the protein in this salad comes from.

items.name: Fortified Sufokian Salad
items.description: The Sufokians quickly spotted that eating seafood stimulated their brains, but not their muscles. That's why they came up with this recipe.

items.name: Amaknian Chips
items.description: Gordo McRamsay himself invented this platter of greasy carbs, which soon became a staple at Amaknian festivals.

items.name: Fortified Amaknian Chips
items.description: This princely dish of devastatingly complex haute cuisine is mainly eaten by the nobility at Amaknian festivals.

items.name: Cottage Pie with Onion
items.description: If you want killer breath, look no further than this cottage pie, and eat it for every meal.

items.name: Fortifying Cottage Pie with Onion
items.description: Your breath will also be fortified after a mouthful of this rather powerful cottage pie.

items.name: Bontarian Terrine
items.description: In Brakmar, the recipe for this dish has been adapted to include genuine morsels of Bontarian Militiamen.

items.name: Fortifying Bontarian Terrine
items.description: This dish is popular with Bontarian officers who are often out in the field.

items.name: Tasty Goulash
items.description: A favourite of the people, this goulash can be whipped up using any kind of bargain-basement meat.

items.name: Fortifying Tasty Goulash
items.description: This goulash can only be created using the most rare and select of meats.

items.name: Countrywoman Pan Fry
items.description: Only women are permitted to cook this dish, which has obviously set the anti-sexist organisations by the ears.

items.name: Fortifying Countrywoman Pan Fry
items.description: Only women are allowed to eat this dish, which has obviously set the Bow Meow among the pigeons when it comes to the associations for the protection of men's rights.

items.name: Three-Bean Pemmican
items.description: The Brakmarians have hijacked the production of this dish and are now deploying the people who eat it as living bombs.

items.name: Fortifying Three-Bean Pemmican
items.description: The gastric escapes caused by the digestion of this dish are particularly explosive.

items.name: Brakmarian Grillade
items.description: The Brakmarians have adapted their cooking to fit their environment, which explains the local custom of grilling just about anything, such as roadkill, long-lost relatives, you name it.

items.name: Fortifying Brakmarian Grillade
items.description: This grillade is difficult to perfect because not every prisoner reacts in the same way to the lava bath.

items.name: Sweet n' Sour Marinade
items.description: This dish is highly prized by adventurers who haven't got time to waste on cooking a separate starter, main course and dessert.

items.name: Fortifying Sweet n' Sour Marinade
items.description: This all-in-one dish is holding its own in the stakes against energy bars.

items.name: Black Pudding
items.description: Black pudding has the reputation of being bigger, grosser, and having a more distinctive flavour than white pudding. It's also black.

items.name: Fortifying Black Pudding
items.description: Apparently black pudding is stronger than white pudding, but it's impossible to say for sure, as nobody's ever seen them arm-wrestle.

items.name: Spiced Stew
items.description: If you get into a stew when it comes to combat, you'll end up as cannon fodder.

items.name: Fortified Spiced Stew
items.description: Telling the cook they made a hash of it doesn't do justice to this dish.

items.name: Restorative Goulash
items.description: This dish is distributed in military canteens in order to maintain morale.

items.name: Fortifying Restorative Goulash
items.description: Like an extended visit from your mother-in-law, excessive consumption of this dish can cause hallucinations, depression and memory disorders.

items.name: Tenderloin
items.description: Nothing particularly interesting about this meat, but it's good stuff all the same.

items.name: Fortifying Tenderloin
items.description: It seems you can be both tender and firm, as this tenderloin demonstrates.

items.name: Hind's Quenelle
items.description: 57 varieties, all of them bland and covered in tomato sauce.

items.name: Fortifying Hind's Quenelle
items.description: They may not be any good, but they'll make you stronger if your stomach can digest them without bringing them back up.

items.name: Game Andouillette
items.description: Eat this sausage with respect, because you might find yourself in its place after the next manhunt.

items.name: Fortified Game Andouillette
items.description: The uncleansed tripe in this sausage gives this andouillette properties that are highly sought after by both adventurers and bodybuilders alike.

items.name: Smoked Sausage
items.description: Although this is less popular than the ever sought-after sausage sorbet, smoked sausage is still appreciated for the unique taste of the final mouthful.

items.name: Fortified Smoked Sausage
items.description: It's mainly due to the extreme elasticity of this shape-memory sausage that adults get told off for playing with their food.

items.name: Kokoko Recycler
items.description:
You can upgrade an alliance prism by adding this module and then extracting the magic essence of any thingamajig you want in order to craft other stuff, which you can sell for ten times the price of a whatchamacallit.
It has been set up to distribute the gains in favour of the alliance, who then share the gains fairly among the people (10% for the character and 130% for the alliance).

items.name: Bow Meow Emoticons
items.description: Emoticons, now with extra Bow Meow!

items.name: Bow Wow Emoticons
items.description: They say a Bow Wow is an adventurer's best friend...

items.name: Bilby Emoticons
items.description: Be there, be square.

items.name: Al Howin Emoticons
items.description: For all your Drowsy Hollow cosplay needs.

items.name: Kongoku's Chest
items.description: The excess energy released by Kongoku made this chest appear.

items.name: Voldelor's Chest
items.description: This chest holds all of Enurado's missing gold.

items.name: Warrior of KOs' Chest
items.description: This massive chest holds extremely heavy and tough items.

items.name: Anatak's Chest
items.description: This chest appears where lightning strikes.

items.name: Zatoishwan's Chest
items.description: Only a very inebriated person can find this chest.

items.name: LeChouque Patter
items.description: This machine will gently soothe a mount by patting it in all the right places, making it less aggressive.

items.name: Emote Scroll: Ethyl
items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Pandawa class's special emote.

items.name: Fortifying Flesh Bullion
items.description: This bullion is not too hot, not too cold, not too spicy, and not enough. In fact, you feel like you're eating a cloud.

items.name: Emote Scroll: Elemental
items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Huppermage class's special emote.

items.name: Huppermage Rune
items.description: Diverse information about the Huppermages.

items.name: Bytbul Eidolonic Veil
items.description: Have you always dreamed of looking like a Bytbul? Now, with the power of dimensional technomagic, it's possible!

items.name: Sucatrose Eidolonic Veil
items.description: Have you always dreamed of looking like a Sucatrose? Now, with the power of dimensional technomagic, it's possible!

items.name: Jammy Jack Eidolonic Veil
items.description: Have you always dreamed of looking like a Jammy Jack? Now, with the power of dimensional technomagic, it's possible!

items.name: Annoyed Catichan Eidolonic Veil
items.description: Have you always dreamed of looking like an Annoyed Catichan? Now, with the power of dimensional technomagic, it's possible!

items.name: Emote Scroll: Duelist
items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Duelist emote.

items.name: Huppermage Elixir
items.description: A good slug of this and you'll be teleported to the Huppermage Temple. Known side effects: hiccups, apparition of in-laws, hair loss, dog breath, untied shoelaces, successive red traffic lights.

items.name: Joris Emoticons
items.description: Now your character can be every bit as expressive as Joris!

items.name: Snikandy
items.description: This candy, dedicated to the famed Sniikzy, won all the votes in a popularity contest.However, the crafting company of candies – sour, caustic, bitter, spicy, corrosive, burning, biting or sardonic (the famous SCBSCBBS) – is very attached to names which are easy to pronounce, and wanted to show their good taste by renaming it.

items.name: Emote Scroll: Deploy Bontarian Wings
items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Deploy Bontarian Wings emote.

items.name: Emote Scroll: Deploy Brakmarian Wings
items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Deploy Brakmarian Wings emote.

items.name: Atcham's Chest
items.description: This chest holds the loot from a thousand misdeeds.

items.name: Emote Scroll: Lucky
items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Ecaflip class's special emote.

items.name: Ecaflip Feed
items.description: After having tasted this delicious potted feed, you'll be making claw marks everywhere... for a while, at least.

items.name: Bloody
items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Sacrier class's special emote.

items.name: Colousses Lightning Thrower
items.description: This terrifying wooden machine will launch a little lightning bolt at any creatures that get too close – which is the basis for the third most popular form of entertainment in the region. This machine is also great for increasing your mount's stamina – just tie it to its tail, sit back and enjoy the show!

items.name: Ush Patter
items.description: This machine will gently soothe a mount by patting it in all the right places, making it less aggressive.

items.name: Catseye Manger
items.description: This manger is the perfect gift for your trusty mount, if you can find a happy balance between starving and overfeeding it. Take your mount to the manger when it begins to grow weak and it will take care of the rest.

items.name: Gisgoul Potion
items.description: A smell of coagulated blood emanates from this potion, and consuming it will make you appear instantly in the Tower of Gisgoul.

items.name: Arachnee Elixir
items.description: By drinking this elixir in one gulp, you have a 50% chance of being transformed into an Arachnee. But you're best not finding out what happens when it doesn't work.

items.name: Astrub Kitchen Soup
items.description: This delicious, aromatic soup causes pestilential flatulence. It's not surprising that it's so popular in Astrub.

items.name: The Weight Escape
items.description: The events described in this book are refuted by the official authorities, which is probably the best guarantee of their truthfulness.

items.name: Araknas Chest
items.description: This chest doesn't contain the remains of the poor bugger who was liquefied by Arachnee venom, but the Araknas Sacred Stones User Guide. What are you waiting for to open it?

items.name: Regenerative
items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Eniripsa class's special emote.

items.name: Seemyool Capturing Net
items.description: Extremely resistant, this net enables you to capture the wildest of mounts, provided you first succeed in hypnotising or distracting them.

items.name: Emote Scroll: Psychotic
items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Masqueraider class's special emote.

items.name: Sack of Mahaquany
items.description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Mahaquany.

items.name: Sack of Salikronia
items.description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Salikronia.

items.name: Sack of Quisnoa
items.description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Quisnoa.

items.name: Sack of Limpet
items.description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Limpet.

items.name: Sack of Sepiolite
items.description: This enormous sack contains an impressive quantity of Sepiolite.

items.name: Diving Certificate
items.description: This certificate awards you the title of "King of the Dive".

items.name: Rygurgal Certificate
items.description: This certificate awards you the title of "Koutoulou Fhtagn".

items.name: Tritun Certificate

items.name: Lemon Fortunawa Cookie
items.description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "A white Kwak on a lake is never fake!"

Eating this cookie will increase your Agility in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.

items.name: Strawberry Fortunawa Cookie
items.description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "Balance is classy. The opposite isn't always true."

Eating this cookie will increase your Intelligence in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.

items.name: Api Fortunawa Cookie
items.description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "Dofus plantus, nerfus sadidus." This cookie tastes like the fortune writer's tears.

Eating this cookie will increase your Strength in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.

items.name: Plum Fortunawa Cookie
items.description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "Whoever dirties his quill, darkens his page."

Eating this cookie will increase your Chance in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.

items.name: Strawberry-Lemon Fortunawaduo Cookie
items.description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "The hero reading this message is a Iop!" Finally, someone who appreciates you the way you deserve.

Eating this cookie will increase your Intelligence and Agility in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.

items.name: Api-Strawberry Fortunawaduo Cookie
items.description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "This is not a proverb." The message leaves you feeling confused.

Eating this cookie will increase your Strength and Intelligence in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.

items.name: Plum-Strawberry Fortunawaduo Cookie
items.description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "Fighting alongside a disciple of Iop teaches you bravery; fighting alongside a disciple of Sram teaches you solitude."

Eating this cookie will increase your Chance and Intelligence in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.

items.name: Api-Lemon Fortunawaduo Cookie

Eating this cookie will increase your Strength and Agility in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.

items.name: Api-Plum Fortunawaduo Cookie
items.description:
You manage to make out the following words through the bland shell of this Pandawa cookie: "When shadows disappoint, light remembers." You get a feeling someone is trying to send you a message.

Eating this cookie will increase your Strength and Chance in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.

items.name: Plum-Lemon Fortunawaduo Cookie

Eating this cookie will increase your Chance and Agility in exchange for Vitality during your next fight.

items.description:
Shariva's magic subtly alters the perceptions of those around you to give them the impression you've become a someone, finally.
This transformation is only temporary. It will dissipate as soon as you engage hostilities against an opponent, whoever they may be.

items.name: Hobnobourglass
items.description: This timeless little hobnob will make any adventurer who has the corresponding magnet happy. Consume without moderation.

items.name: Ephemeral Prophet Certificate
items.description: This certificate awards you the title of "Ephemeral Prophet".

items.name: Purse of 20,000 Kamas
items.description: This purse is very heavy – it must be worth a fair bit.

items.name: Scrollsayer Finalist Certificate
items.description: This certificate awards you the title of "Scrollsayer Finalist".

items.name: Fleaster Fatal Blow
items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Fleaster fatal blow.

items.name: Experience Tempotion
items.description: This potion will transfer experience acquired in a past life to you.

items.name: Countryside Highways and Byways: The Evil Forest (previous edition)
items.description: "This book is a must-read for anyone who wants to discover the best itineraries in the Evil Forest!" This blurb on the book jacket shows that the author had admirable intentions. Too bad the book was never finished... and is now obsolete.

items.name: Geoglyphs for Ninnies
items.description: Ever dream of deciphering geoglyphs? This book is for you!

items.name: Umeshushu
items.description: Those are not actually eyeballs floating in the bottle; they're just apriplums. That means they're a lot less creepy than you thought and altogether a poor idea for an Al Howin accessory. But Umeshusu is delicious. Just take a sip and let yourself be carried away on fruit-filled waves of nectar to a land of unsuspected flavour.

items.name: Pandazahi
items.description: This dry beer is recommended by the Grandapan for unclogging the ears and thereby hearing the voice of the goddess better.

items.name: Pandaporo
items.description: If it's Pandaporo, pour me some more-o!

items.name: The Paths of Pandawushu
items.description: A summary of the major principles of Pandawushu.

items.name: Pandakwak
items.description: Nicknamed "bamber nectar", this speciality beer from the port of Osakwa is brewed from bamboo milk and seawater. This subtle and original brew is a radical cure for freshwater addiction.

items.name: Seasonal Warrior 650 Certificate
items.description: This certificate awards you the title of "Seasonal Warrior 650".

items.name: Spiritual Certificate
items.description: This certificate awards you the title of “Team Spirit".

items.name: Pandawushuka Apprentice Certificate
items.description: This certificate awards you the title of "Apprentice Pandawushuka".

items.name: Master of Martial Paths Certificate
items.description: This certificate awards you the title of "Master of Martial Paths".

items.name: Perfect Reinforced Soul Stone
items.description: Unique in its kind, this stone lets you capture the most recalcitrant souls.

items.name: 99% Alcohol
items.description: Drinking this alcohol neat is strongly discouraged.

items.name: Kronengob
items.description: This beer is so strong that it could kill any goblin that tries to swallow it. Only Leprechauns have any chance of surviving it... and they win every time. Lucky devils.

items.name: Flat Okirhym
items.description: Created by Carol Loois, rhymer extraordinaire, and perfected by Keg O'Beer, this beer is a favourite among poets and artists long on thirst and short on inspiration.

items.name: Shaké
items.description: Lighter than fermented bamboo milk, but just as treacherous.

items.name: High-Fermentation Shaké
items.description: A version of shaké with much higher alcohol content. Consume in moderation.

items.name: Betadjutant Certificate
items.description: This certificate awards you the title of "Betadjutant".

items.name: Swipolifis
items.description: "Swipe your troubles away on Nolifis with a tall Swipolifis."

items.name: One for the Road
items.description:
This drink – according to a persistent rumour – allows the dying to reach Externam without getting lost along the way. It's probably why alchemists use it when concocting a mysterious elixir...
If you've always dreamed of wandering like a wayward soul, downing this tankard will make your dream come true until your next fight.

items.name: Ferrier's Elixir
items.description:
Drinking the contents of this vial will stimulate your sixth sense; you'll be able to see the legendary Route of the Dead in Pandala.
(You need to be on Nolifis Island to use this potion.)

items.name: Yugo Fatal Blow
items.description: Use this scroll to learn Yugo's fatal blow.

items.name: Corsair Bag
items.description: This bag surely contains valuables.

items.name: Monkiki'ng Bag
items.description: This bag surely contains valuables.

items.name: Samurai
items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Samurai emote.

items.name: Limo d'Grobe
items.description: Who says that Pandawa taste buds can't appreciate non-alcoholic beverages? Sure, this fancy lemonade with a funny name is only popular among Pandawas who've taken up permanent residence on Nolifis Island. But dead or deader, they're still Pandawas.

items.name: Fermented Mimilk
items.description: Bow Meows have the right to drink alcoholic beverages, too!

items.name: Cania Bandits' Treasure Chest
items.description: This chest contains a few trinkets stolen by Nomekop, Edasse and Eratz. With a little luck, what you want will be inside.

items.name: Gnole de Grobe
items.description: Brewed on Nolifis Island, this top-fermented beer would get even the most tongue-tied spirit talking.

items.name: Virizeon's Breath
items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Virizeon's Breath emote.

items.name: Nyan Beer
items.description: This drink will make you purrrr!

items.name: Mam Pla Sauce
items.description:
This sauce is Niki Minawa's speciality. It achieves the incredible feat of making everything taste like Snapper.
If you drink it, you will start to look like a Kloon Snapper. Don't worry, the effect is not permanent and fades as soon as you start fighting.

items.name: Grand Puddah Beer
items.description: Now here's a drink that'll won't leave you as cold as marble... or will it?

items.name: Folded Words
items.description:
When you unfold these words, you will receive a paper haiku.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Blackened Words
items.description:
When you unfold these words, you will receive an ink haiku.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Harvested Words
items.description:
When you unfold these words, you will receive a haiku of the two kingdoms.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Obscure Words
items.description:
When you unfold these words, you will receive a Wukin haiku.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: Enlightened Words
items.description:
When you unfold these words, you will receive a Wukang haiku.
(Double-click to use.)

items.name: The Tale of the Scholar and the Moumouse
items.description: This traditional Pandalan legend has been adapted into a theatre play. To watch a performance, head to the ink theatre in Akwadala.

items.name: Poet Certificate
items.description: This certificate awards you the title of "Soul of a Poet".

items.name: Pandako's Swane
items.description: This paper Swane won't grant all your wishes, but it will follow you wherever you go. However, it will fly away as soon as you start to fight... probably because it's a symbol of peace for all Pandalans.

items.name: Pizwa
items.description: Gluttony is bad! If you eat this pizwa, you may feel luckier at the end of your fights, but you will also feel much heavier – unless you are a true Ninjawa Turtle.

items.name: Wholewrite Bread
items.description: This bread made with unbleached and unrefined paper is much healthier for you than plain write bread.

items.name: Pumperinkel
items.description: The colour makes it look rather unappetising, but you will definitely gain some energy from eating this bread.

items.name: Celestial Candy
items.description: Words cannot describe the exquisite taste of this sweet.

items.name: Tsingtawo Beer
items.description: This beer has become hugely popular outside Pandala thanks to Pandawas who travel the world.

items.name: Bambooze
items.description: Fancy a sip of bamboo?

items.name: Light Strong Beer
items.description: Pandazahi improves hearing, but the light strong beer from the Forbidden Inn does much more: it gives your lugholes a deep cleaning. Much more effective than any cotton buds. It's even credited with making the ears of an unfortunate fan who attended a Pandalida concert grow back... Taste tested, approved and consumed by the Grandapan himself (in its most concentrated format).

items.name: Bag of Ink Snappers
items.description: This enormous bag contains an impressive quantity of Ink Snappers.

items.name: Bag of Bendable Crystals
items.description: This enormous bag contains an impressive quantity of bendable crystals.

items.name: Bag of Liquid Crystals
items.description: This enormous bag contains an impressive quantity of liquid crystals.

items.name: Bag of Paper Tulips
items.description: This enormous bag contains an impressive quantity of paper tulips.

items.name: Barroll Brewski
items.description: This beer will make you wobble like a rolling barrel.

items.name: Faded Leaves: An Anthology
items.description: In remembrance of a voyage in the land of words, as pages turn like fleeting blossoming seasons, a paper goblin awaits.

items.name: Words to Speak By
items.description: This book may well have been the first ever written by a Pandawa's hand... Or perhaps it's merely a dream whose pages you turn out of curiosity on dreamy nights only to forget what you've read when dawn breaks.

items.name: Fruit Juice
items.description: Boost your energy with this drink that contains no artificial colours or preservatives!

items.name: Sushiwi
items.description: This delicate slice of raw fish, perched on mound of rice from the paddy fields of Akwadala, simply melts in the mouth.

items.name: Makwi
items.description: Be careful when eating this makwi because it rolls off the tongue.

items.name: Confinuum Exodus Certificate
items.description: This certificate awards you the title of "Confinuum Exodus".

items.name: Ninjawa Beer
items.description: Drink this beer to become as agile as a Ninjawa Turtle. Which one can be a bit of a toss-up, though.

items.name: Shogun Tofugawa Manger
items.description: This manger is the perfect gift for your trusty mount, if you can find a happy balance between starving and overfeeding it. Take your mount to the manger when it begins to grow weak and it will take care of the rest.

items.name: Koumiho Dragobutt
items.description: This leather-clad mechanical posterior will excite the coolest of male mounts. It will even turn the ever-dignified Crack Beauty into a wild, panting, sweaty mess. It seems to work on Iops as well. *shudder*

items.name: King Imagami Slapper
items.description: This mechanical contraption is designed to slap your mount across the face when it disobeys you. It used to be used in schools to teach young Iops to count to 5.

items.name: Queen Amirukam Dragobutt
items.description: This leather-clad mechanical posterior will excite the coolest of male mounts. It will even turn the ever-dignified Crack Beauty into a wild, panting, sweaty mess. It seems to work on Iops as well. *shudder*

items.description: Created by Carol Loois, rhymer extraordinaire, and perfected by Keg O'Beer, this beer is a favourite among poets and artists long on thirst and short on inspiration.

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Origami emote.

items.name: Kwing for a Day 651 Certificate
items.description: This certificate awards you the title of "Kwing for a Day 651".

items.name: Wakficionado Certificate
items.description: This certificate awards you the title of "Wakficionado".

items.name: Dimensional Black Pudding
items.description: Taking a bite of this piece of black pudding will give your dimensions a whole new dimension.

items.name: Warrior
items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Warrior emote.

items.name: Fallen from the Heavens
items.description: The legend of the creation of paper arts, or how one thousand swanes allowed a star to join the eternighty.

items.name: Guardian of the Arts Certificate
items.description: This certificate awards you the title of "Guardian of the Arts".

items.name: Experience Tempotion
items.description: This potion, made from Tempokens, will give you a great deal of experience.

items.description: Straight from another dimension, this small box is here to give a little help to brave souls who like getting their hands dirty.

items.description: Its tangy tartness makes it a favourite among Pandalan cooks, who use it liberally in most dishes. Taken alone, this syrup is an effective pick-me-up. Just watch out for the excessive salivation.

Oink?

items.name: Kabaal Drinking Trough
items.description: This drinking trough is a refreshing spot, a mount's paradise, it can either quench its thirst or have a quick dip if the season is hot. Filled with water and a few drops of magic potion, it will help your special friend grow big and strong.

items.name: Shushette
items.description:
When it's hotter than blazes, there's nothing like a long swig at 6.66° to wet your whistle! Stronger and redder than many ales, this Shuchuan pepper beer is loved by demons everywhere. Apparently, even Bontarians will shell their shouls – shorry, sell their souls – for a sip...
Consume with moderation if you don't want to find yourself looking at an exorcist through beer goggles, pickle your faith, or trigger the Eli-hiccup-alypse.

items.name: Wor'Mhole Potion
items.description: The label on this potion says: "A straight line is the shortest path from one point to another." If you aren't feeling nauseous, you can use it to enter the ephemeral dimension.

items.name: Rain Call
items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Rain Call emote.

items.name: Katiay Clan Standard
items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Katiay Clan Standard emote.

items.name: Legendary Whitebeerd Beer
items.description: Brewed by a Stubbyob from a vanished clan, this beer is probably among the rarest in the World of Twelve. Savour it as its unique status deserves, and enjoy the legendary hangover it's sure to leave you with.

items.name: Valiant Scrollsayer Certificate
items.description: This certificate awards you the title of "Valiant Scrollsayer".

items.name: Signed Bonta Gobbowl Ball
items.description: This ball made of pure gobball wool has been signed by the players on Bonta's official team. Just by touching it, you can imagine yourself on the field, being skilfully passed from hand to hand until you land behind the goal line... Of course, most normal people would imagine themselves as a player rather than the ball, but that's neither here nor there.

items.name: Signed Brakmar Gobbowl Ball
items.description: This ball made of pure gobball wool has been signed by the players on Brakmar's official team. Just by touching it, you can imagine yourself on the field, being skilfully passed from hand to hand until you're slammed down behind the goal line. Of course, most normal people would imagine themselves as a player rather than the ball, but that's neither here nor there.

items.name: Emperor Supporter
items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Emperor Supporter emote.

items.name: Solary Supporter
items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Solary Supporter emote.

items.name: Avalanche of Quests
items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Avalanche of Quests emote.

items.name: Eternal Conflict Patter
items.description: This machine will gently soothe a mount by patting it in all the right places, making it less aggressive.

items.name: Nutcracker
items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Nutcracker emote.

items.name: Nutcracker Emote Potion
items.description:
For a few seconds, you'll finally deserve to be called a nutcracker.

Note: this is a single-use potion.

items.name: Brakmarian Nachos
items.description:
Support your favourite gobbowl team while enjoying these delicious nachos from the Black City.

Double-click to temporarily transform into a gobbowler.

items.name: Bontarian Popcorn
items.description:
Support your favourite gobbowl team while enjoying this delicious popcorn from the White City.

Double-click to temporarily transform into a gobbowler.

items.name: Memory of a Bontarian Soldier
items.description: When you fight for Bonta, death is only the first step in eternal glory. Honour this soldier's memory, and wear his armour with respect.

items.name: Memory of a Brakmarian Soldier
items.description: When you join the Brakmarian army, you're in it for life... and the afterlife too. Will you be able to brandish this soldier's pike as proudly and boldly as he did?

items.name: Memory of an Azure Warrior
items.description: The sacrifice made by the knights of the Valiant Heart has inspired generations of Bontarians. Many gifted swordsmen and talented swordswomen achieved illustrious feats as they drew their noble blades to defend their ideals. May they guide you to the light as well!

items.name: Memory of a Blood Warrior
items.description: The most important thing isn't to win, but to be a part of the action. Did Hyrkul and Djaul break down and cry after a setback? No, never! They pulled themselves up and kept fighting. Breaking bones, smashing skulls, and spilling the blood of one's enemies... An ideal worthy of the darkest of fates!

items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Skiing emote.

items.description: Want to visit Otomai? Just drink this potion. Swallowing it all in one shot will save you vial-uable time next time you need to hassle the World of Twelve's most famous alchemist for something.

items.name: Ecaflipus Ankor
items.description: They say that Oktapodas used Ankors to move about. Fishermen from the World of Twelve seem to have perfected an Ankor that takes you to a specific place.

items.name: Kitsous' Delight
items.description: These rice-stuffed tofu fritters will give you a healthy dose of energy. They're very popular with Pandalan spirits, and especially with the goddess Inali's messengers. So don't be surprised if you hear bewitching voices or evil cackling after eating them.

items.name: Tumult Finery
items.description: This set reflects your involvement in a life that goes beyond the ordinary. You've finally got your hands on it after many a twist and turn, making you one of a tiny minority to have accomplished this feat.

items.name: Ochre Dragon
items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Ochre Dragon emote.

items.name: Hell Mina Manger

"In order to enjoy the full range of flavours when consuming this beverage, make sure you've already applied the Lon Cheur update."

items.name: Tehlaython Corktail
items.description: Every year, all profits from the sale of this beverage are donated to the Twelvian Association for Rare Alteration Research.

When you drift back to reality, you'll be surprised to see that you've traded your fingered hands for a pair of large, rounded pincers.

items.name: Tehlayskop Corktail
items.description: Be careful not to bump sharply into anything once you've drunk this corktail – you might just explode into a truly impressive amount of tiny, sharp pieces.

items.description: If you want your mount to have more experience without spending hours training it, this potion is for you.

items.name: La Tourmenteuze
items.description: Drowning your torments in alcohol is never the right solution, and even less so with this beer. On the other hand, if you just want to drink like a dark knight to terrify your friends, cheers!

items.name: Riktus Bockus
items.description: Whether swordfighter, enchantress, archer or seasoned fighter, always put on a toothy smile to maintain the maskarade!

items.name: Bworkenbräu
items.description: Sip this superior brew to calm down those bothersome brainwaves that occasionally tickle your neurons. You'll understand why beer is the only thing a Bwork will ever pause to think about.

items.name: Ice Storm Ale
items.description: Get a firm grip on your glass and don't let it slip. Spilling such a fine beer on the floor could cast quite a chill on your evening.

items.name: Pandissident Pint
items.description: At the end of a tough battle, there's nothing better than a cold pint of beer to celebrate your victory, forget your defeat, or just spill something other than blood for a change.

items.name: Dark Crafter's Cup
items.description: Work is health. So here's to yours! Any crafter will tell you that after a hard day of work, it's important to share a friendly moment together before divvying up the loot.

items.name: Skeleton Brew
items.description: Some killjoys will tell you that drinking beer weakens your bones. But the contents of this bottle will do just the opposite.

items.name: Hair of the Bow Wow
items.description: Some Ouginaks don't know whether to take the old saying about "the hair of the bow wow that bit you" literally or figuratively. So to be on the safe side, they treat their hangovers by drinking a pint for breakfast and biting each other's fur. Seems to work, though!

items.name: Zoth-n-Froth
items.description: One of z'ese pints z'not like z'others...

items.name: Big Chief's Beer Horn
items.description: It's said that the Manitou Zoth's horn of plenty never runs dry. Alas, the same can't be said for this one. His fate is one of abundance, and yours one of obedience. But maybe you can switch roles just this once...

items.name: Alliance Renaming Potion (Moderation)
items.description: Use this potion to rename an alliance.

items.name: Sidekick Ale
items.description: This beer can be enjoyed on your own in small sips, or drained in one go on a relaxing night out with your favourite drinking sidekicks.

items.name: Non-Alcoholic Half-Pint
items.description: Tastes great, less filling!

items.name: Olde Eggy
items.description: For once, a popular beer that actually is all it's cracked up to be.

items.name: Forgelance Heritage
items.description: Use this scroll to learn the Forgelance Heritage emote.

items.name: Gut Twister
items.description: Alcohol consumption can be dangerous for your health. Perfect. You love living dangerously!

items.name: Fewmented Cawwot Juice
items.description: How far would you go to get your five fruits and vegetables a day? Pop open this bottle if you dare! But we can't be held wesponsible fow the wesults.

items.name: Firefoux Ginger Beer
items.description: A lot of people imagine they're more attractive when they drink, but in this case it's actually true. Prepare to feel your fouxiest!

items.name: Side Dish
items.description: It's better to eat alone than with the wrong side(kick)... hence this dish.

items.name: Steak in Hunter's Sauce
items.description: A thick, savoury steak before heading out on the hunt to give the monsters a taste of your blade!

items.name: Class Change Potion (20)
items.description: You can use this potion to change class.

items.name: Ephedrya Haven Bag Popocket
items.description: Use this popocket to acquire the Ephedrya haven bag theme and all its decorative elements.

items.name: Stone Cold Lampin'
items.description: Best... enjoyed... ice... cold... and... very... very... slowly.

items.name: Blind Hammer Ale
items.description: Really hits the spot! Sometimes a little too hard...

items.name: Golden Regrets
items.description: Some drink to remember, some drink to forget.

items.name: Pili-Pilsi
items.description: Nicknamed Pili-Peepee by Kanniball children and goblins alike, this beer has a low alcohol content but a powerful taste that comes from the hot pepper lurking just below the foam. Lektor himself once famously remarked that a good pili-pilsi could really "tear your face off" and therefore bring back all kinds of great memories.

items.name: Midnight Mush
items.description: Despite its visual resemblance to mouldy soup, this foam-free beer is said to be an insomniac's best friend. Apparently, it has impressive spororific properties.

items.name: Sewer Brew
items.description: The taste of this brew is enough to make anyone vomit, but the smell is even worse. Best stored in a hermetically sealed vial, ideally far underground.

items.name: Weal Spawkling Lagew
items.description: Stubbyobs don't like that the thick foam gets stuck in their beards. Ah well, more for the rest of us!

items.name: Incarnated Class 653 Certificate
items.description: This certificate awards you the title of "Incarnated Class 653".

items.name: Miss/Mr World of Twelve 653 Certificate

items.name: Sylvaspirit Essence
items.description:
If you're not worried about being hunted by adventurers the next time you go for a walk in the Petrified Forest, go ahead and drink this potion.
Only those who have prayed in the deepest depths of the mystified temple are worthy of quenching their spiritual thirst.

items.description: This chest is solid enough to be thrown at the head of the person who gave it to you if you don't like what's inside. Bear that in mind.

items.name: Simple Ephemeral Brett Tattoo
items.description:
Brett was a swordsman with a fearsome reputation throughout the Cania Plains. He attacked any travellers who crossed his path, supposedly to show them his talent with a blade. It's said that he eventually slew himself in a burst of excessive enthusiasm.
This tattoo will lend you a tiny fraction of Brett's power.

items.name: Simple Ephemeral Tankhor Tattoo
items.description:
Captain Tankhor was a force of nature, a colossal man overflowing with vitality. His ship seemed to be everywhere at once, from the Antinau Sea to the Asse Sea, from Cania Bay to the coast of the Stontusk Desert. His swashbuckling career ended in tragedy, with a sad tale of an anchor, a giant kralove and countless gallons of ink.
This tattoo will lend you a tiny fraction of Tankhor's vitality.

items.name: Simple Ephemeral Looth Tattoo
items.description:
Looth was unmatched when it came to methodically exploring a location or searching a defeated enemy's body to steal their meagre possessions. Rejecting attachments to any clan or gang like the Cania Ruffians, she was driven solely by raw profit motive. She died the way she lived: fast and with terrifying violence.
This tattoo will lend you a tiny fraction of Looth's prospecting talents.
